name: acme-sign
description: Acme Pay's in-house ECDSA P-256 signing and verification library (Python package with a C extension). Fictional library used as sample data.

versions.preview: acme_sign/ecdsa.py, acme_sign/_fastmath.c, tests/ (412 tests), pyproject.toml. Version string 1.4.2.
versions.notes: Release currently deployed to the signing service.
versions.seededDefect: Planted sample defect: verify() does not check that r and s lie in [1, n-1] before the curve computation, so the all-zero signature (r = 0, s = 0) verifies for any message. Same defect class as CVE-2022-21449 (a real 2022 Java ECDSA issue, cited as background only); acme-sign itself is fictional.

versions.preview: Same layout as 1.4.2. verify() gains an explicit range check on r and s; tests/ grows to 418 tests.
versions.notes: Shipped by Acme in response to recommendation rec-001 (Acme internal change 2291).

name: Signing service configuration
description: The signing service's runtime configuration (digest allow-list, key rotation interval, verification flags).

versions.preview: allowed_digests: [sha256, sha384, sha1]; key_rotation_days: 90; verify_strict_encoding: false

name: Wycheproof ECDSA P-256 vectors (sample subset)
description: A 198-vector subset of Project Wycheproof's ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 known-answer tests, re-encoded as raw r||s. Vector numbering in this sample (S-0001 to S-0198) is the lab's own, not Wycheproof's tcId.

versions.preview: 198 vectors: 142 valid, 56 invalid (modified messages, out-of-range r/s, point-at-infinity edge cases).

name: Acme CI signing test results (export)
